allow: Bash(curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/projects -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"key":"WORK","name":"Work Platform","description":"PFA project"}')
PowerShell(docker exec workflow-db psql -U workflow -d workflow -c "SELECT id, issue_key FROM issue WHERE id IN \(65,66,70\);")
PowerShell(docker exec workflow-db psql -U workflow -d workflow -c "SELECT id, project_key, name FROM project ORDER BY id;")
PowerShell(docker exec workflow-db psql -U workflow -d vectordb -c "SELECT metadata->>'issueId' AS issue_id, metadata->>'issueKey' AS issue_key FROM issue_vector WHERE metadata->>'issueId' = '86';")

PowerShell(docker exec workflow-db psql -U workflow -d vectordb -c "SELECT metadata->>'issueId' AS issue_id, metadata->>'issueKey' AS issue_key, metadata->>'projectKey' AS project FROM issue_vector ORDER BY \(metadata->>'issueId'\)::int DESC LIMIT 8;")

PowerShell(docker exec workflow-db psql -U workflow -d workflow -c "SELECT c.issue_id, i.issue_key, c.model_version, c.review_status, c.confidence, c.created_at FROM ai_classification c JOIN issue i ON i.id = c.issue_id ORDER BY c.issue_id DESC LIMIT 8;")

PowerShell(docker exec workflow-db psql -U workflow -d workflow -c "SELECT i.id, i.issue_key, i.title, i.description IS NULL AS desc_is_null, i.created_at, c.model_version FROM issue i LEFT JOIN ai_classification c ON c.issue_id=i.id WHERE i.id IN \(86,87,88\);")
